name: codebase-retrieval-tools
description: Tools for codebase retrieval evaluation and query generation.

interface.shortDescription: Query-generation and retrieval evaluation helpers for codebases.
interface.longDescription: A small Codex plugin for agents that need to generate challenging codebase queries and evaluate whether retrieval reduces repeated search work.
defaultPrompt: Generate codebase-specific queries that would stress a RAG retrieval pipeline and reduce repeated grep calls.
Assess whether retrieval context would save tokens compared with manual repo exploration.
Suggest questions that force cross-file and cross-module reasoning.
